The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Chronicle of The After-School Wars [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ma Le, a psychologist who calls himself a "suicide intervention master," makes money off the misfortunes of others. One day, a "birthday star" falls from the sky and hits Ma Le. Having accidentally inhaled divine energy, Ma Le is told that the world is on the verge of collapse and that only by gathering the four gods of wind, rain, thunder, and lightning, who have been banished to the mortal realm, can everything be changed. Thus, the gods and mortals embark on a hilarious, fantastical, and thrilling journey...

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle
programme.desc: Things are not going well for Bruce Crompton. His wife is threatening to clear out the messy warehouse where he stockpiles his military kit; he paid well over the odds for a rusty shell of a German Army transport vehicle; and the twins can’t fix a WWII vehicle called a Kübelwagen, made by Volkswagen. But his luck is due to change. In amongst the clear out he finds an incredible pair of trousers made in a German concentration camp, that are worth thousands. And a Military historian discovers the rusty shell he bought is not just rare, but unique, and worth a mint.

But his luck is due to change. In amongst the clear out he finds an incredible pair of trousers made in a German concentration camp, that are worth thousands. And a Military historian discovers the rusty shell he bought is not just rare, but unique, and worth a mint.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: It is a road of mountain passes and India’s access to the roof of the world – the Himalayas. This 475-kilometre long route at the northernmost tip of the Indian subcontinent connects the cities of Manali and Leh at the heart of the Ladakh region. The term “highway” applies quite literally, since the route traverses five of the highest drivable mountain passes in the world – among these the Lohtang La at 3,978 metres above sea level, the Lachulung La at 5,059 metres and the Tanglang La at 5,325 metres. Crossing these passes is a challenge for both vehicle and man. The mountain peaks, still snow-capped even in the depths of summer, wide variety of vegetation and the fantastic and craggy landscape turn any journey into a captivating adventure.

programme.title: Karamo
programme.desc: Thomas Villani says he hired the defendant, Frank Colluci, to move his furniture and in the process, he broke a pane of glass in his Tommy Bahama curio cabinet. First he said he’d fix it, then he said he’d hire someone to fix it, and now, here they are, because he’s done nothing. Thomas is suing for $5,000, the cost of the cabinet. Frank says he is ready, willing, and able to fix it, but the plaintiff never allows him to install the replacement piece. He’s accused of causing the customer some pain.

programme.title: Artist's Academy
programme.desc: If one page is good, a whole bunch is better. This show focuses on books. First, host Julie Fei-Fan Balzer uses colorful paint pens to create an art journal page of doodled leaves. Next, Joe Rotella shares secrets of book binding demonstrating a piano hinge style binding. Then, Stacy Julian makes a treasures theme album with gold glittery elements. Last, Julie uses an electronic cutter to make numerous triangle shapes to embellish a cover for an album.

The show is known for its gentle humor, engaging storytelling, and colorful animation that appeal to preschool-aged children. With each episode, young viewers are invited into Kipper's world where everyday experiences turn into magical explorations, fostering a love for learning and imagination.

Alongside his friends, including Tiger the dog, Pig, and Arnold the piglet, Kipper embarks on a variety of adventures that emphasize friendship, curiosity, and the joy of discovery. The show is known for its gentle humor, engaging storytelling, and colorful animation that appeal to preschool-aged children. With each episode, young viewers are invited into Kipper's world where everyday experiences turn into magical explorations, fostering a love for learning and imagination.

Alongside his friends, including Tiger the dog, Pig, and Arnold the piglet, Kipper embarks on a variety of adventures that emphasize friendship, curiosity, and the joy of discovery. The show is known for its gentle humor, engaging storytelling, and colorful animation that appeal to preschool-aged children. With each episode, young viewers are invited into Kipper's world where everyday experiences turn into magical explorations, fostering a love for learning and imagination.

programme.title: Peztronauta
programme.desc: "Domi Kids es una serie musical animada en 3D que da vida a las alegres y cálidas aventuras diarias de la familia Domi, compuesta por cinco integrantes. Con música animada y divertida, y actuaciones de múltiples personajes, el programa ofrece una gran variedad de temas, historias atractivas y escenas diversas. Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: Chronicle of The After-School Wars [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ma Le, a psychologist who calls himself a "suicide intervention master," makes money off the misfortunes of others. One day, a "birthday star" falls from the sky and hits Ma Le. Having accidentally inhaled divine energy, Ma Le is told that the world is on the verge of collapse and that only by gathering the four gods of wind, rain, thunder, and lightning, who have been banished to the mortal realm, can everything be changed. Thus, the gods and mortals embark on a hilarious, fantastical, and thrilling journey...

Having accidentally inhaled divine energy, Ma Le is told that the world is on the verge of collapse and that only by gathering the four gods of wind, rain, thunder, and lightning, who have been banished to the mortal realm, can everything be changed. Thus, the gods and mortals embark on a hilarious, fantastical, and thrilling journey...
